mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, task_id, task_process_id, process_id, scheduling_id, product_id, product_type, quantity, team_id, user_id, report_type, wage_quota_type, wage, price
mapper.select:
SELECT IFNULL( SUM( price ), 0 ) FROM mes_building_produce_team_report_price WHERE
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y' )
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y-%m' )
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' )= DATE_FORMAT( #{dateTime}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
and task_type_enum = #{taskTypeEnum}

SELECT workshop_id, workshop_name, production_line_id, production_line_name, team_id, user_name team_name, day_time, IFNULL( sum( mete ), 0 ) mete, IFNULL( sum( price ), 0 ) price FROM ( SELECT workshop.id workshop_id, workshop.`name` workshop_name, production_line.id production_line_id, production_line.`name` production_line_name, price.team_id team_id, user_link.user_name user_name, DATE_FORMAT(price.create_time,'%Y/%m/%d') day_time, CASE price.task_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN price.inspection_quantity * part.net_weight WHEN 2 THEN price.inspection_quantity * artifact.net_weight WHEN 16 THEN price.inspection_quantity * assemble.net_weight END mete, price.price FROM mes_building_produce_team_report_price price LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = price.product_id LEFT JOIN tech_assemble assemble ON assemble.id = price.product_id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part part ON part.id = price.product_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report report ON report.id = price.team_reoprt_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = report.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = production_line.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link user_link ON user_link.team_id = price.team_id AND user_link.bool_delete_enum=0 AND user_link.bool_leader_enum = 1
price.process_id=#{processId} and price.inspection_quantity > 0
and date(price.create_time)>=date(#{startTime})
and date(price.create_time)<= date(#{endTime})
and workshop.id =#{workshopId}
and user_link.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%')
) a GROUP BY workshop_id, workshop_name, production_line_id, production_line_name, team_id, user_name, day_time

SELECT price.team_reoprt_id, workshop.id workshop_id, workshop.`name` workshop_name, production_line.id production_line_id, production_line.`name` production_line_name, gro.id groups_id, gro.`name` groups_name, price.team_id team_id, user_link.user_name team_name, price.day_time, report.quantity, project.name project_name, project.serial_number project_serial_number, price.wage_quota_type,
machine_part.serial_number, machine_part.specification, machine_part.net_weight, CASE price.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN price.quantity * machine_part.net_weight / 1000 WHEN 2 THEN price.quantity * machine_part.length / 1000 WHEN 4 THEN price.quantity * machine_part.surface_area / 1000000 ELSE price.quantity END mete,
classification.classification_name product_name, artifact.net_weight, CASE price.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN price.quantity * artifact.net_weight / 1000 WHEN 2 THEN price.quantity * artifact.length / 1000 WHEN 4 THEN price.quantity * artifact.surface_area / 1000000 ELSE price.quantity END mete,
CASE price.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN config.`name` END product_name,
CASE price.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN assemble.serial_number END serial_number,
CASE price.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN assemble.net_weight END net_weight,
CASE price.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN assemble.specification END specification,
CASE price.task_type_enum WHEN 16 THEN CASE price.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN price.quantity * assemble.net_weight / 1000 WHEN 2 THEN price.quantity * assemble.length / 1000 WHEN 4 THEN price.quantity * assemble.surface_area / 1000000 ELSE price.quantity END END mete,
price.wage, price.wage_quota_type, price.price FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%Y/%m/%d' ) day_time, task_id, task_process_id, process_id, product_id, quantity, team_reoprt_id, team_id, wage_quota_type, task_type_enum, task_order_id, sum( wage ) wage, sum( price ) price FROM mes_building_produce_team_report_price
process_id=#{processId}
and date(create_time)>=date(#{startTime})
and date(create_time)<= date(#{endTime})
GROUP BY day_time, task_id, task_process_id, process_id, product_id, quantity, team_reoprt_id, team_id, wage_quota_type, task_type_enum, task_order_id ) price
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part machine_part ON machine_part.id = price.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = price.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification classification ON classification.id = artifact.structure_class_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble assemble ON assemble.id = price.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config config ON config.id = assemble.assemble_config_id
LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report report ON report.id = price.team_reoprt_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON report.task_id=task.id LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON task.project_id=project.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups gro ON gro.id = report.groups_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = gro.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = gro.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link user_link ON user_link.team_id = price.team_id AND user_link.bool_leader_enum = 1
and gro.workshop_id =#{workshopId}
and user_link.user_name LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%')
ORDER BY price.day_time

SELECT project_id 'project.id', project_name 'project.name', project_short_name 'project.short_name', project_serial_number 'project.serial_number', IFNULL(SUM(mete), 0 ) mete, IFNULL(SUM(area), 0 ) area, IFNULL(SUM(price), 0 ) price FROM ( SELECT project.id project_id, project.`name` project_name, project.short_name project_short_name, project.serial_number project_serial_number, price.quantity * artifact.net_weight mete, price.quantity * artifact.surface_area area, price.price FROM ( SELECT task_id, product_id, quantity, SUM( price ) price FROM mes_building_produce_team_report_price price WHERE price.process_id IN ( SELECT id FROM mes_building_process WHERE type = 1 AND product_type = 2 ) AND price.task_type_enum = 2 GROUP BY task_id, product_id, quantity ) price LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON price.task_id = task.id LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON project.id = task.project_id LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = price.product_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT( project.create_time, '%Y' )= DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y' ) ) a GROUP BY project_id, project_name, project_short_name, project_serial_number ORDER BY project_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m') month, SUM(price) amount FROM mes_building_produce_team_report_price WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') = #{year} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(rprice.create_time, '%m') month, SUM(price) amount FROM mes_building_produce_team_report_price rprice LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON task.id = rprice.task_id WHERE rprice.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND task.project_id in
#{id}
AND DATE_FORMAT(rprice.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = task.project_id )
AND task.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
GROUP BY month
